attributes.name: Torius Vin
attributes.powers:
At the start of your turn, reveaal this card to recharge the ally Grogul, the ally Snick, or the weapon Captain's Cutlass from your discard pile.

Reveal this card then recharge it or another ally to add 1d6 and the Swashbuckling trait to your check.

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 1d6 and the Swashbuckling trait to your checks.
